posts.title: The tragedy of the maximizer
posts.description: Maxxing is everywhere, but when everything is a metric to optimize, there’s never an enough. On the tragedy of “more” and the question maximizers avoid.

posts.title: Hardly working - still burned out
posts.description: Every morning at 6:15… Saties Gnosienne starts playing. The sweet delirium of not knowing what this day has in store quickly dissipates the moment your brain kicks in and reminds you that it is yet another Tuesday full of meetings, tasks, and more. posts.title: The eternal mog
posts.description: In recent weeks, I developed an unhealthy interest in the world of looksmaxxing. Not because the concept of trying to adhere to unrealistic beauty standards is new to me.
